data.gist: Flow cytometry and CFU assays were used to confirm the donor's BMAX and BMAC showed the previously reported MSC differences.
data.plain: Prior work showed BMAX device processing retains glycosaminoglycan-rich matrix and yields MSCs that behave differently from matched BMAC. Here, both preparations from this donor were checked by flow cytometry for relative stem cell yield and plated to count colony-forming units.
